description: Crawl and capture a target domain into a clone dataset + manifest — WordPress-aware schema inference, Payload collections, and a Next.js + Payload + Postgres scaffold manifest (vdd/clone-manifest.json). Pass the domain as description. Writes vdd/clone-dataset.json, vdd/clone-manifest.json, and vdd/clone.md, overwriting any existing versions in place. Open-world: makes network requests to the target site and reads its sitemap and same-origin links. Use for cloning an external site; it is not part of the VDD phase pipeline, so for the normal init→validate flow call those phase tools instead. Parameter relationships: description is the target domain and statement is the desired outcome (both optional); maxPages, timeoutMs, concurrency, crawl, and browser tune the crawl and refresh=true bypasses a cached dataset.

browser.description: Clone: run browser/static capture (default true). Local stdio server only; ignored by the hosted endpoint

concurrency.description: Clone: concurrent crawl workers, 1-16 (default 8). Local stdio server only; ignored by the hosted endpoint

crawl.description: Clone: run the crawl (default true). Local stdio server only; ignored by the hosted endpoint

maxPages.description: Clone: max pages to crawl, 1-5000 (default 200). Local stdio server only; ignored by the hosted endpoint

projectRoot.description: Project root: directory that constitution.md and the vdd/ folder are written to and resolved against. Relative paths resolve from the current working directory; keep the same value across every phase (default ".")

refresh.description: Clone: force re-crawl, ignore a fresh cached dataset. Local stdio server only; ignored by the hosted endpoint

timeoutMs.description: Clone: per-request timeout in ms, 1000-60000 (default 10000). Local stdio server only; ignored by the hosted endpoint
